rootCauseOneLine: The Tasks List/Board view lives only in the URL: parseTasksRoute maps a marker-less project route to "list", and the breadcrumb (topbar.tsx:283), sidebar fallback (sidebar.tsx:269) and new-project dialog (new-project-dialog.tsx:153) hardcode view:"list"; no localStorage preference exists unlike the sibling sidebar/list preferences.

prReviews.topFinding: Fixes the root cause (nullable route view + localStorage per-project preference; all four nav sites updated), cherry-picks cleanly onto base, 338 tests pass, browser repro turns green. Low-severity: preference is recorded only via the shell's wrapped navigation.go, so a board reached by deep link/bookmark is not remembered and the next marker-less navigation drops to list (small regression vs the old sidebar carry-over); resolveRoute re-parses localStorage on every render (memoize on subPath).

proposedFix: Make TasksRoute.project.view nullable, keep the parser strict (list|board|null), persist the per-project choice in localStorage and resolve null at render time (as PR #1704 does), but record the preference from the rendered route (effect on subPath when the parsed view is explicit) rather than only in the shell's navigation wrapper, and memoize resolveRoute(parseTasksRoute(subPath)) on subPath.
caveats: Issue overstates scope: the Back chevron/Esc from a task and a reload of a ?view=board URL both keep the board (session ref / URL marker); only marker-less routes (breadcrumb, sidebar, bare deep link, new project) lose it. Tasks plugin is not installed by default on a fresh dev instance (bb plugin install builtin:tasks). Not fixed on origin/main as of base. Repro test file left uncommitted in the worktree at plugins/tasks/shell/issue-1702.repro.test.tsx.
